notes.title: We found a new home for Dimhaven!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,[/b]

We are excited to share the news that [b]Dimhaven Enigmas[/b] has found a new home. The game will be published by [b]Blue Brain Games[/b], the minds behind the acclaimed House of Da Vinci series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211042/2e0eea5edbedd5b5361a766644f12012b15c8106.png[/img]

Starting today, Zadbox Entertainment and Blue Brain Games are officially joining forces to bring Dimhaven to life. We are aiming for a 2025 Q4 release, maintaining our original scope and direction for the game. This partnership is a synergy between two teams who look to push the boundaries of the puzzle genre, and we can’t wait to share more about this cool new chapter in the journey of Dimhaven.

Read more about this partnership at bluebraingames.com/news , and see you on the island!

notes.title: Our plans for 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Explorers![/h1]

We're thrilled to share that we’ve made a lot of progress and Dimhaven is getting cozier and weirder by the day! Our main focus in the past 6 months has been laying down all the groundwork, both gameplay and scenery-wise. Our vision for the world is very clear and the controls, interactions and the overall feel of the game are all coming together.

Check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458980/Dimhaven_Enigmas/]new screenshots[/url] that showcase some of the development.

[b]We're excited to announce that we are launching a Kickstarter campaign next year.[/b]
With the Kickstarter campaign, we will be releasing a fully baked, FREE PLAYABLE DEMO, giving you a sneak peek into the world and a chance to experience Dimhaven firsthand.

Big shoutout to our amazing community - your support inspires us the most. The fact that so many of you are interested keeps us excited to push boundaries, explore new creative options, and ultimately deliver an exceptional game that lives up to your expectations.

Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/dimhavenenigmas]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ZadboxGames]Twitter[/url] for more updates and behind-the-scenes glimpses, and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jRtBq9BuWK]Discord server[/url], be part of the discussion and have a chat with us!

We can't wait to share more exciting news with you soon.

Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays, and for those still on Quern island: Happy Exploring!
